texts.title_text: Presley Gerber, 27, died at a Los Angeles rehab center, medical records confirm.
texts.slide_1_text: Medical examiners confirmed his death but withheld the cause despite his public discussions of mental health challenges.
texts.slide_2_text: Gerber started modeling professionally at 16 with Moschino, later collaborating with Burberry and Dolce & Gabbana.
texts.slide_3_text: His father co-founded Casamigos tequila with George Clooney, though the family requested privacy after the death.
texts.slide_4_text: Gerber openly shared his recovery journey in a 2023 podcast, emphasizing support for others facing similar struggles.
